assessment: Roe et al. provide a large-sample analysis of hemispheric lateralisation in brain structure, synthesising local cortical thickness and surface area data from 7 different datasets. The study provides a rich descriptive catalogue of phenomena related to hemispheric anatomical asymmetries. These results are convincing and will prove an important point of reference to neuroscientists who might want to compare their own future results to the ones from this large and varied data set.
